title: Circle Membership Allowance on the Days a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Booking Is Held Open
content:
The membership allowance is added last. Where the membership standing on the profile is active, the tier it stands on adds at least the top member extension days to the published return window, and its dues carry nothing outstanding, the top member hold days are added. Where the membership standing on the profile is active, the tier it stands on adds at least the paid member extension days to the published return window, and its dues carry nothing outstanding, the paid member hold days are added. Where neither holds, nothing is added.

The top member extension days are 45. The paid member extension days are 15. The top member hold days are 4. The paid member hold days are 2.

## The three things read from the membership

The days in question are the days a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection booking is held open.

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership. Three things about it are read: whether it stands active, the return window extension days its tier publishes, and whether its dues carry anything outstanding.

| The membership standing on the profile | Its tier's published return window extension | Its dues | Days added |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active | 45 days or more | nothing outstanding | 4 |
| active | 15 days or more but fewer than 45 | nothing outstanding | 2 |
| active | fewer than 15 days | nothing outstanding | nothing |
| active | any figure | something outstanding | nothing |
| not active | any figure | any | nothing |

The two conditions are compound: the tier's published extension and the dues standing at nothing are both required, and an active membership carrying dues outstanding adds nothing however long its published extension.

## Both sides of each threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing a return window extension of 45 days, its dues carrying nothing outstanding.* Forty-five is 45 or more, so 4 days are added.

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing 44 days, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* Forty-four is fewer than 45 but 15 or more, so 2 days are added.

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing 15 days, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* Fifteen is 15 or more, so 2 days are added.

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing 14 days, dues carrying nothing outstanding.* Fourteen is fewer than 15. Nothing is added.

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing 60 days, dues carrying 12.00 USD outstanding.* The dues are not at nothing. Nothing is added.
